task.title: AI helpers: estimate nutrition and describe an eat-out meal
task.description:
Owner decisions (2026-11-18): these two helpers are in the first build; recipe drafting and a weekly review are not. Both use the user's own AI key.

Wanted:
- Estimate nutrition: on a recipe without numbers, 'Estimate nutrition' fills per-serving figures from its ingredients, marked as estimates. A planner action fills in everything missing for the week.
- Describe an eat-out meal: on an Eat out slot, type or paste a description (for example a restaurant order) and get a named meal with estimated macros. This is the owner's main use for pasted text: capturing macros for meals out, not shopping.
- Same missing-key and provider-error messages as recipe import, linking to Settings.

Notes: structured model output, as the import already uses. Show the estimate for confirmation before saving. Depends on the nutrition fields from the nutrition story.

comments.author: dylan@dgoings.com
comments.body: Owner decision 2026-11-18: estimating nutrition is always a button with confirmation, never automatic on import, in line with not calling the model unless needed. Build after the nutrition story's fields, totals and targets.
